blocks.text: Needs review by a South African attorney or the appointed Information Officer before use. This is a drafting outline, not legal advice and not an approved document. The statutes and instruments named are pointers for the reviewer: POPIA (Act 4 of 2013) section 35 (children, where consent is the ground); Children’s Act 38 of 2005.
Dear parent or guardian of [Fill in: learner name, written by the school by hand],

[Fill in: school name] is starting to use an education platform called Infinite-AI to help teachers plan lessons and support learners. This letter explains what will happen with your child’s information.

items: What we use: [Fill in: data items]
Who can see it: [Fill in: roles]
Your child’s details are never typed into an AI tool. They are replaced with codes first.
A teacher checks anything the AI drafts.

blocks.text: Whether consent is needed depends on the ground the school relies on. Counsel or the Information Officer must decide this before the slip is used.
Consent slip (if the school relies on consent)

rows: I consent to the uses above

blocks.text: Questions: [Fill in: Information Officer name, email]. You may withdraw consent at any time by telling the school.
